changes.text: Passwordless sign-in with Magic Links, including rate limiting and security policies.
Sign-up, profile and display name management.
Session management: view the current session, list all sessions and sign out everywhere.
Role management and fine-grained access control for users and roles.
Administration area with user management: ban, unban, delete and permanently delete users.
Wall of shame listing banned users with their reason and expiry.
Impersonation of other users, recorded in the audit log on their behalf.
Audit log with filtering, searching and paging.
The audit log shows names (users, roles, grants, emails and so on) instead of raw identifiers.
Email confirmation tracking and an email sender with templates.
Footer with the application name and version, and this changelog page.
Frontend views now use Bootstrap, including automatic light and dark themes.
Requests are logged with correlation ids, and ETag support was added to the Web API.
Sensitive configuration values are masked, and data protection keys are protected by a certificate.
